name: Classic Pancakes
description: Fluffy golden pancakes perfect for weekend mornings

instructions.text: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and add milk and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir until just combined.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle over medium-high heat.
Pour batter onto griddle using approximately 1/4 cup per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook until golden brown.

furtherNotes: For extra fluffy pancakes, let the batter rest for 5 minutes before cooking.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A rich and hearty Italian meat sauce served over spaghetti

instructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Saute onion until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and tomato paste. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside

instructions.text: Cream together butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
Mix in flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.

furtherNotes: For softer cookies, remove from oven when edges are set but centers still look slightly underdone.
